changes: Bulk task actions: open More > Edit multiple tasks to set or clear due dates, add assignees, or mark tasks complete across sections. Highlighted rows keep selection separate from completion.
Plan and Roadmap: organize dependencies, edit tasks from graphs and timelines, and forecast completion across the project or by person.
Status reporting: track work status, schedule health, delays, and task updates. See downstream impact and compare daily history.
A cleaner Material-style interface separates selection controls from bulk actions, confirms saves with snackbars, and simplifies project tools and mobile navigation.
Improved mobile spacing, touch targets, and tab transitions.
Simplified invitations and collaboration, with clearer search, notifications, and conversation cues.
Fixed interaction issues across projects, tasks, and chat.
Task and project chat buttons now show message counts and highlight active conversations.
Refreshed task editing with clearer labels and smoother focus states.
Added a chat-based AI assistant to help create and organize projects.
Added task effort and priority, global task search, and an Assigned to me filter.
Expanded project collaboration with invitations that return you to the invite after sign-in, plus JSON export.
Added project covers, automatic icons, live icon search, and X sign-in.
Refreshed the dashboard and mobile toolbar, added swipe navigation and helpful tips, and fixed project deletion issues.
Launched Connections with shareable contact invitations.
Made tab switching and updates faster, and added deletion confirmations.
Made task details easier to open and close by clicking the task name.
